240-5470-7297-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
240-5470-7297-8227.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

4881-5396-6909-8199.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{W}{U} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4881-5396-6909-8199.description:
Cast Trickery Charm by paying {U}, causing Carnage to become a Kithkin until end of turn
Cast Brigid's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 4, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 6.

435-4247-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Auratog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-728-4742.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Grimgrin twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2060-2744-3327-3899.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
2060-2744-3327-3899.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4324-4552-7824.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Workshop Elders.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-3263-7803.easyPrerequisites: Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-3263-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
114-3263-7803.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

2445-3099-4762-7741.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Shang-Chi and Branching Evolution.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

4017-4506-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4017-4506-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1115-1368-4289-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1115-1368-4289-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

193-1124-2724-3080-4608.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five enchantments.
193-1124-2724-3080-4608.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Aminatou's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Activate Aminatou's second ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Exchange of Words.
When Exchange of Words leaves the battlefield, its ability from Wormfang Manta's textbox triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

2173-2438-5220-7452.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

333-5256-7424.notablePrerequisites: Changing Loyalty attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-5256-7424.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

129-1247-2113.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Kinnan triggers, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Pili-Pala's other ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

539-5412-7035.description:
Cast Earthbending Student by paying its mana cost
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Earthbending Student
When Earthbending Student dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability.
Repeat from step 3.

5073-5220-6273-6900.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
5073-5220-6273-6900.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3755-5051-5078-6918.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

2173-4050-5220-6537.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Tarpan.
When Tarpan dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tarpan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Tarpan trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Tarpan from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

1850-4426-5411.description:
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-4426-5411.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

460-539-1526.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Circle of Dreams Druid.
Cast Scryb Ranger by paying {1}{G}.
Repeat.

3587-5358.description:
Deal damage to Boros Reckoner.
Boros Reckoner triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve the second Boros Reckoner trigger, dealing damage to itself.
Repeat from step 2.
3587-5358.notes: You can use Wayta's fight ability to deal damage if desired.

3918-4824-5139.description:
Activate Trazyn using Relic of Sauron's ability by tapping it, adding {U} and either {U}, {B} or {R}.
Activate Trazyn using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
3918-4824-5139.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can instead use Relic of Sauron's second ability.

2034-3372-4785-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
2034-3372-4785-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {C}{C}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

2146-3054-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
2146-3054-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

2459-4050-4763-6290.description:
Cast Lightwheel Enhancements either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {W}, attaching it to Rograkh.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Rograkh, adding {W}.
When Rograkh dies, Koll triggers, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1409-2060-5648.notablePrerequisites:
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Agent Frank Horrigan.
Crystalline Crawler has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1409-2060-5648.description:
Activate Agent Frank Horrigan by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Agent Frank Horrigan enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Agent Frank Horrigan trigger, causing you to put two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Agent Frank Horrigan.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2034-2591-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Redcap Gutter-Dweller, adding {C}{C}.
When Redcap Gutter-Dweller dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Redcap Gutter-Dweller from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Redcap Gutter-Dweller enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

405-2232-2757-4365.description:
Cast Resolute Reinforcements by paying {1}{W}.
When Resolute Reinforcements enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Resolute Reinforcements trigger, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Resolute Reinforcements to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Soldier token, untapping a basic Plains you control.
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat from step 8 for the remaining Soldier token.
Repeat from step 1.

2558-4303-4639-4659-4694.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, adding {C}{C}.
Sword of the Meek dies, triggering Slagstone Refinery, creating a tapped Powerstone token that enters the battlefield as a 1/1 creature due to March of the Machines and Unctus.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield, but not attaching itself to the Powerstone due to Sword of the Meek becoming a creature.
Repeat.

423-539-3392-4577.notablePrerequisites:
At least two reprieve counters on Magnanimous Magistrate.
You have lost life this turn.
423-539-3392-4577.description:
Activate Children of Korlis by sacrificing it, gaining life equal to the amount of life you have lost this turn.
Magnanimous Magistrate triggers, causing you to remove a reprieve counter from it and return Children of Korlis from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Evolution Sage triggers, proliferating, putting a reprieve counter on Magnanimous Magistrate.
Repeat.

225-3470-4967.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-3470-4967.description:
Activate Thawing Glaciers by paying {1} and tapping it, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Lotus Cobra and Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Thawing Glaciers.
Repeat.

193-1367-3039-3502.notablePrerequisites:
Yennett does not have summoning sickness.
Liliana has at least three loyalty counters.
Aminatou has at least two loyalty counters.
Opponents are unable to kill Yennett.
193-1367-3039-3502.description:
Activate Liliana's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, searching your library for Nexus of Fate, shuffling your library and putting Nexus of Fate on top of your library.
If Liliana has less than three loyalty counters remaining, activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Liliana.
Otherwise, activate Aminatou's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, drawing Nexus of Fate and putting it back on top of your library.
Proceed to your combat phase, and declare Yennett as an attacker.
Yennett triggers, revealing Nexus of Fate from the top of your library and causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Nexus of Fate, getting an extra turn after this one and shuffling it into your library.
Repeat each turn.

1964-1987-2427-3277.description:
Activate Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Meteorite and Izzet Chronarch, blinking them.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Meteorite enters the battlefield, deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.
